changes.title: IDEA dispute resolution by state first published
changes.summary: U.S. Department of Education counts of special education disputes under IDEA Part B for the nation, 50 states, DC and five territories, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24: 39,151 due process complaints, 9,927 written state complaints and 12,914 mediation requests in 2023-24.
